name: @longevity/engine
description: Deterministic rules engine — owns every prescription in the Longevity OS.

scripts.clean:stale: node -e "const{readdirSync,statSync,rmSync}=require('fs'),{join}=require('path');const walk=d=>{for(const e of readdirSync(d)){const p=join(d,e);if(statSync(p).isDirectory()){if(e!=='node_modules')walk(p)}else if(/\.(js|d\.ts|js\.map|d\.ts\.map)$/.test(e)){rmSync(p);console.log('removed stale artifact',p)}}};for(const d of ['src','fixtures','test'])walk(d)"
